name: @octocodeai/codex-plugin
description: Octocode code research tools and public skills for Codex
author: Guy Bary <bgauryy@octocodeai.com>

scripts.clean: rm -rf plugin.json mcp.json assets skills LICENSE
scripts.lint:own: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json src scripts tests README.md ARCHITECTURE.md
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json src scripts tests README.md ARCHITECTURE.md
scripts.verify:own: yarn build && yarn lint:own && yarn typecheck && yarn test
scripts.prepack: yarn build && yarn typecheck && yarn test
